We are seeking an experienced Maintenance Engineer to lead preventive and corrective maintenance activities for Integrated Pot Control Panels (IPCP) and potline automation systems within an aluminium smelter environment.
Bachelor's degree in electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or Automation Engineering (Diploma holders with relevant experience may be considered).
3-5 years of maintenance experience in an aluminium smelter or heavy process industry.
Hands-on experience with Alesa Pot Control Systems, PLCs, HMIs, instrumentation, and industrial communication networks.
Strong troubleshooting skills in automation, control systems, electro-pneumatic equipment, and field instrumentation.
Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, and control logic diagrams.
Experience with SAP PM and maintenance planning is preferred.
Maintain and troubleshoot IPCP cabinets, PLCs, HMIs, instrumentation, and field devices.
Support network reliability, SCADA systems, and fiber optic communication infrastructure.
Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent corrective actions.
Manage preventive maintenance schedules, work orders, and spare parts.
Lead maintenance activities safely in compliance with LOTO and pot room safety requirements.
Provide technical support and guidance to technicians and maintenance teams.
q: Direct experience with Alesa Panels, Pot Micro-Panels, anode effect control systems, and potline automation.
Knowledge of Profibus, Modbus, Industrial Ethernet, and Fiber Optic Networks.
